<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the base peak at m/z 194.0862 is interpreted as the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈193.079 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass and the observed M+1 isotopic intensity (~13 % of the base peak, consistent with ~11–12 carbons) is C₁₁H₁₃O₃. Therefore the molecular formula is C11H13O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H13O3</final_answer>
